comments.comment: See http://atlassian.gridgain.com/jira/browse/GG-10395 (looks like the same).

There are several issue with swap/unswap:

  • 'unswap' can be called for obsolete entry (created test CacheSwapUnswapGetTest reproducing issue when cache.get can return null after successful cache,put)
  • if both offheap and swap are enabled and entry is evicted from offheap to swap: there is a time window when entry neither in heap/offher/swap. Also when value evicted from offheap is written to swap (GridOffHeapEvictListener in GridCacheSwapManager) it is necessary to get lock for evicted entry.

Fixed issue with 'unswap' on obsoleted entries (unswap should call checkObsolete).
Fixed issue with offheap to swap eviction: when GridUnsafeMap.freeSpace is called we can not remove evicted entry from offheap, instead entry key and version are stored in thread-local context and when unwindEvicts is called need to create cache entry and inside entry lock check that value with the same version is still in offheap, in this case remove from offeap and write to swap.
With these fixes CacheSwapUnswapGetTest does not fail anymore. Need to check if this fixes assert in indexing.

Except issues in cache there was race in GridH2AbstractKeyValueRow.getValue: it was possible to read from swap wrong value (fixed by Sergey Vladykin).

Attached patch with all fixes.

Added failover tests using offheap/swap. Found bug: during preloading old value could replace swapped value, fixed GridCacheMapEntry.initialValue to check key is not in swap.
